hooks.name: Related tests and typecheck on save
hooks.description: When a TypeScript file under src/ or scripts/ is saved, run the Vitest files related to it and tsc --noEmit. Shell command only, no agent prompt. run-logged.sh passes the exit status through and writes one evidence line, also when the run is cut short; its 110 s deadline sits below the 120 s timeout here, which is about three times the slowest measured run (36.0 s, docs/BUILD_LOG.md).

action.command: sh .kiro/hooks/bin/run-logged.sh "Related tests and typecheck on save" 110 node .kiro/hooks/bin/related-tests.mjs
